description.value: High Tide Grill is a casual fast-food spot on Bowen Island serving hot dogs and burgers. Bowen Island is a popular cycling destination accessible by ferry from Horseshoe Bay, making a stop here a natural fit for cyclists exploring the island. The no-drive-through format suggests a walk-up or counter-service setup typical of small island eateries.
